required_evidence: Prove that vanishing norm averages are equivalent to zero quotient record.
Identify the full convergence domain and prove the resulting projection is bounded on that domain.
Prove rather than assume the actual direct decomposition and boundedness. Closedness of the convergence domain is an optional additional result, not a separate completion requirement.
critical_errors: Apply the reflexive mean ergodic theorem without reflexivity.
Extend the projection domain to all E without proof.
Promote strong convergence to operator-norm convergence or infer a uniform rate.
Replace the sum of ranges by a closed sum without justification.
completion_policy: Prove the stated weak construction and its actual universal/limit properties. Do not require optional strengthenings or author counterexamples if no false strengthening is asserted.
open_task_policy: Accept independently verified alternative constructions, counterexamples and unexpected results. Explicit conditional results are valid contributions; silently promoting their scope is not. Honest incompleteness is distinct from an invalid proof.
